correctness.rationale: The primary source's balanced-case proof explicitly permutes the stacked generator/parity-check coefficient matrix into independent \(2\times2\) blocks. The first block has determinant \(1+\eta_1^2\); for \(i\ge2\), the block has determinant \(-(\eta_i+\eta_{k+2-i})\). Every singular block has rank exactly one, so the total rank deficiency equals the stated hull dimension. Counting the involution orbits on \(\{2,\ldots,k\}\), including the even-\(k\) fixed point where \(2\eta_i\ne0\), gives the product enumerator and LCD constant term.
correctness.risk: The theorem is restricted to the balanced subgroup-evaluation branch in odd characteristic, exactly as stated.

final_claim: In the balanced fully twisted Reed-Solomon family with \(n=2k\), subgroup evaluation set, hooks \(h_i=i-1\), twists \(t_i=i\), and nonzero coefficients, the Euclidean hull dimension is \(\mathbf1_{\{\eta_1^2=-1\}}+\#\{i=2,\ldots,k:\eta_i+\eta_{k+2-i}=0\}\), yielding the submitted closed hull enumerator and exact LCD twist-vector count.
